page.overview:
Who is Cockroach Devil?

The |Gokiburi no Akuma}} is a devil who embodies the concept of cockroaches. He is a minor antagonist in the Justice Devil arc.

The Cockroach Devil is gigantic and has a meshwork appearance of a skeletal layer on its body that covers its head but does not fully cover its exposed torso. It resembles a humanoid cockroach and has antennae on its head and across its back.

The Cockroach Devil seems to be calculating and vengeful, hoping to catch Chainsaw Man off-guard by dropping a highschool teenager and a car full of elderly people in order to test Chainsaw Man's ability to be a "superhero." It shows little regard for other devils, paying no notice when it accidentally killed the Bat Devil.

At some point, the Cockroach Devil got into a fight with Chainsaw Man. In the midst of their battle, they accidentally killed the Bat Devil, saving Asa Mitaka and Yuko. After their battle continued to rage across the city, Denji chose to quickly kill the Cockroach Devil instead of saving bystanders, and instead saved a cat. Their battle was covered on the news.
